context_requirements: Expression of CYP19A1 (aromatase) to generate endogenous estrogens
Estrogen receptor (ESR1) expression and functional ER signaling
Dependence on autocrine/paracrine estrogen for proliferation (e.g., ER+ breast cancer)
Postmenopausal/estrogen-deprived hormonal context in vivo; in vitro lines must supply androgen substrate for aromatization
falsifiers: No decrease in estrogen-responsive/proliferation genes (e.g., CCND1, MYC, ESR1, PGR) in MCF7 at 24 h
Equivalent transcriptional response in ER-negative lines (A375, A549, PC3) as in MCF7
No difference between aromatase inhibitor and vehicle in any line at either time point

evidence.supports: Aromatase inhibitor (anastrozole) treatment of ER+ breast tumors downregulates proliferation-associated and classical estrogen-dependent genes.
Anastrozole inhibits androgen-stimulated growth and ER transcriptional activity in aromatase-overexpressing MCF-7 cells, indicating dependence on aromatase/ER signaling.
